summary: 3 film announcements, 4 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Supermax
film.announcement: Jason Clarke joins the action-thriller as a cast member. The project is being developed by Amazon MGM Studios and Miramax.

film.title: Spring Breakers 2
film.announcement: Bella Thorne is set to write, direct, and star in the sequel after producers tapped her following her directorial debut.

film.title: Artificial
film.announcement: Monica Barbaro is in Luca Guadagnino's OpenAI-produced film about artificial intelligence.

tv.title: Monsters of God
tv.announcement: HBO greenlights a reptilian docuseries from Tiger King's Eric Goode.

tv.title: Boston Blue
tv.talent: Will Estes (reprising role from Blue Bloods)
tv.announcement: Will Estes is reprising his Blue Bloods role for the new series Boston Blue.

tv.title: Tucci in Italy
tv.announcement: Stanley Tucci's Emmy-nominated series is relocating from Italy to the United Kingdom for the next season.

tv.title: My Life with the Walter Boys
tv.announcement: Season 4 is in development with Ashby Gentry discussing Alex's healing journey and a new love triangle.
